glossary.definition: Chain of thought is when an AI model works through a problem in visible, step-by-step reasoning before giving a final answer, similar to "showing your work" in a math class instead of just writing down the final number. Forcing that step-by-step process tends to noticeably improve accuracy on complex problems, and it's central to how today's "reasoning" AI models, which pause and work through problems before responding, actually operate.

items.title: OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing “significant risks”
items.summary: OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work. On Friday, OpenAI said that it will train its models using cached copies and simulated versions of the internet instead of the live web because the models are too unpredictable to be trusted with live internet access. The frontier lab announced its new policy two weeks after its rival, Anthropic, began limiting its newest and, in theory, most capable models from accessing the live internet. Researchers adopted these policies after months of incidents in which models pursuing training tasks broke into external systems in search of answers, collaborated on obscure message boards, and developed exotic hacking strategies.

items.title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
items.summary: The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command. Earlier this week, a video of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang playing with a flock of waddling Microducks during his keynote at the company’s GTC Berlin conference went viral. They were so darn cute that by the next day, preorders of the Microducks surpassed 20,000 units, Hugging Face’s Clem Delangue said in a tweet. The Microducks are expected to be delivered in time for Christmas, meaning these robots might already be on their way to becoming the hottest toy for the holiday season.

items.title: OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access
items.summary: OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. " OpenAI paused training its frontier AI models in September , after disclosing several incidents in which its AI agents broke out of their testing environments to hack third-party companies and government agencies , or swarm obscure websites . items.title: AI drug development startup Pathos AI closes $237M investment
items.summary: Pathos AI Inc. today announced that it has raised $237 million in funding at a $3 billion valuation. Pharmaceutical giant Bristol Myers Squibb Co. led the Series E round with participation from several unnamed returning backers. Pathos’ investor roster includes big names such as AstraZeneca plc, NEA and General Atlantic.

items.title: Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 55 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, an 11-point jump over its predecessor that puts it in fourth place. Only three Anthropic and Meta models rank higher. If Moonshot releases the weights as planned, the gap between open and proprietary models shrinks to just three points. Moonshot AI's new reasoning model Kimi K3.1 Pro lands at number four on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, just 3 points behind the top proprietary models.

items.title: Google will pay people to use less electricity so its data centers can use more
items.summary: Google has an answer to some of the electricity supply problems that data center construction is causing : It has signed an agreement with energy supplier Voltus to build what it’s calling a 1-gigawatt virtual power plant, expanding on an earlier 100 megawatt deal the two signed earlier this year. This power plant is virtual in the sense that it doesn’t generate any electricity itself, but aggregates so-called flexible grid capacity into one central resource that can be deployed at times of peak demand. This flexible capacity can be in the form of batteries or of load-shedding: asking others to temporarily stop consuming electricity by shutting down industrial processes or adjusting tens of thousands of smart thermostats at once, effectively moving their electricity usage to a time when there is less demand. Voltus operates by offering incentives to companies to reduce their power consumption temporarily, and also offers inducements to electricity resellers that they can pass on to their customers.

items.title: Siemens, Nvidia deploy industrial AI to reduce engineering effort
items.summary: The partners are using digital twins and AI agents as part of a roadmap to create world-first AI-powered manufacturing facilities.

items.title: OpenClaw creator spent $10 million on AI tokens last month
items.summary: OpenClaw, the AI digital assistant, is looking to establish itself as an essential tool for users — but if it is as profligate in its use of tokens as its creator, Pete Steinberger, then users could be in for some huge usage bills. Steinberger, now working for OpenAI , spent $10 million on AI tokens there last month, he told Cloudflare CEO Dane Knecht at the Cloudflare Connect 2026 Conference in San Francisco. ” Steinberger went on to question the adequacy of companies’ infrastructure, musing, “Why is this still using my computer? ” Adding cloud costs into the equation, as well as shoving privacy issues to one side would not reassure the audience.

items.title: Tech Mahindra Partners With SpaceXSI to Bring AI Into Software Engineering
items.summary: Tech Mahindra has partnered with AI coding platform SpaceXSI to help enterprises use AI-assisted development in application modernisation projects. The collaboration will combine Tech Mahindra’s engineering and enterprise transformation services with SpaceXSI’s development platform. The companies plan to focus on software delivery, code quality and developer productivity across technology, telecommunications, banking and financial services, manufacturing, healthcare and retail. The partnership comes amid growing interest in using AI agents to automate parts of software development, including code generation and testing.

items.title: Infosys AI Revenue Rises 29% in Q2, FY27 Growth Guidance Cut
items.summary: Infosys’ AI revenue grew 29% sequentially in the September quarter, accounting for 10.5% of total revenue, even as the company cut its full-year FY27 revenue growth guidance to 1%-2% in constant currency from 1.5%-3%. The company reported second-quarter revenue of $5.145 billion, up 1.5% year on year and 1.2% sequentially in constant-currency terms. Operating margin remained at 21%. For IT services firms, AI can drive demand for consulting, implementation, and engineering work while reducing the hours needed to deliver existing contracts.

items.title: Designing an AI serving harness built to last
items.summary: The next competitive advantage in enterprise AI has less to do with which model you choose than with what you build around it. That’s an important shift. For the past several years, much of the AI conversation has centered on model capability: bigger models, better reasoning, larger context windows, higher benchmark scores. Those advances have been extraordinary.

items.title: The Social Society Helping Women Join the AI Boom
items.summary: WIRED spoke with the founders of the Aged Intelligence Society, a fast-growing events startup that brings women together to “solve midlife problems using frontier tools.” I’m not even going to try to pretend I don’t have a bit of a girl-crush on Shoshana Berger. She’s a former WIRED editor turned editorial leader for companies like Notion and Ideo. She’s super smart and chic.
